headline: Rupee Co-operative Bank replay: the signal was an evidence boundary, not a clean warning
dek: This is a historical replay, not current news and not a forecast. Rupee Co-operative Bank’s record shows why a balance-sheet screen must separate a filing-period signal, a market-price signal, and an absence of scoreable evidence.

review_notes: Deleted unsupported causal assertions about Rupee Co-operative Bank’s pre-event balance-sheet path.
Separated filing-period evidence, market-price evidence, and model outputs throughout.
Retained all institution-specific missing-data, eligibility, construction-PIT, and validation disclosures.
Added explicit product-boundary language and source links.

corrections.summary: Three co-operative bank failures in the India crisis record are dated at their onset, the first RBI directions restricting depositors, instead of the later licence cancellation. The India figures were regenerated, and Failure Radar tier publication is paused pending re-validation.
corrections.note: **Correction, 3 November 2026.** LiquiLens now dates three co-operative bank failures in its India crisis record at their onset, the first RBI directions restricting depositors, instead of the later licence cancellation: Madhavpura Mercantile Co-operative Bank on 13 March 2001 (previously 4 June 2012), CKP Co-operative Bank on 2 May 2014 (previously 30 April 2020) and Rupee Co-operative Bank on 22 February 2013 (previously 22 September 2022). Sources: RBI press releases of [7 June 2012](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=26606), [5 May 2014](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=31124) and [25 February 2013](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=28200). Each bank's only scored filing fell after its onset, so all three are now unscored for insufficient data rather than flagged. This article originally gave 2022-09-22, the day Rupee Co-operative Bank's licence cancellation took effect, as its default date; the text below now gives 2013-02-22. Failure Radar tiers are now paused pending re-validation. Board states and validation statistics below are as served on the publication date, and the text is otherwise as published.
